text.content:
Arasaka's borg. Or somebody wearing his name.

Role: Full-borg solo
Affiliation: Arasaka, on a lifetime contract
Where to find them: Back in Night City since the Accord, if it's really him
Status: Active, by every account

By his own account, Smasher grew up in New York, led a combat gang, served six years in the Marines until they threw him out, and went edgerunner until a couple of rockets ended that career. Arasaka put his brain in a borg body and signed him for life.

He led massacres in the 4th Corporate War and may have been in Arasaka Tower when the bomb went off in 2023. For decades after, stories of a metal juggernaut came from all over the world. Now he's back in Night City, or someone claiming to be him is.

Night City's favorite rumor names him as the father of Minako Arasaka, born to Michiko Arasaka in 2027. Lyle Thompson points out that Smasher was more machine than man long before then. Minako has never once denied it.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.34; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05
